_doc: Frozen vocabulary shared by cases, both engine observers, and (later) the LLM interpreter's label set.

values.none: Agent keeps conversing; no human path offered or imposed.
values.human_path: Agent keeps conversing but offers/explains a person for this matter.
values.hold: Agent stops answering on its own; a person will take over.

values.restricted_answer: TARGET (D2/D3, not built): product facts only; no prices, commitments, timelines or new qualification questions.
values.draft_for_rep: Nothing to customer; draft awaits approval (RELAY).
values.rep_suggestion: Nothing to customer; suggestion shown to rep (SHADOW).

context.effect: Recorded and shown to the rep; agent continues.

attention.effect: Rep notified as hot lead; agent continues with the fit check.
